newsitem.title: UK: Coca-Cola brings back bottle in UK.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola brings back bottle in UK.

text.p: Coca-Cola is introducing a new 330 millilitre glass bottle to suit the tastes of British coke drinkers, the company said on Tuesday.
The new bottle, which maintains the familiar curved shape, will go on sale from next week and will be unique to this country.
Coke is only available in bottles in pubs and clubs, shops having swapped over to cans in the 1970s.
"The design of the bottle is so closely associated with the product that there was an irresistible pull to bring it back," a company spokeswoman said.
The 330 ml size bottle has been developed for Britain following extensive market research. The bottles on sale in pubs and clubs are only 180 ml.
The launch coincides with the opening of the Coca-Cola Bottle Exhibition at London's Design Museum on May 21.
The exhibition celebrates almost a century of bottling of Coca-Cola, acknowledged as the world's best-known brand.
